suggested_solution: Recalibration: Recalibrate the battery by charging it to 100% and then discharging it completely.
Power Plan: Edit the power plan to Balanced mode and adjust NVIDIA control panel settings to optimize performance.
Driver Updates: Ensure that all drivers, including graphics drivers, are up-to-date.
Thermal Management: Check for thermal throttling issues and consider using a cooling pad or adjusting fan settings.
